title: French Toast with Sweet Brazilian Banana
description: A classic French twist on traditional toast, topped with sweet and sticky Brazilian banana.
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the bread slices in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Flip the bread slices and cook for another 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the banana into rounds.
Once the bread is cooked, place it on a serving plate.
Top each bread slice with a few banana rounds, a drizzle of honey, and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
